name: Yandangornis
isnote: Possibly an avialan; its long tail and the lack of a published analysis leave its position open (Godefroit et al. 2008).
sum: Long-tailed Campanian theropod from the Tangshang Formation of Zhejiang, China, possibly an avialan.
wsnote: Total length about 58.8 cm, of which 30.5 cm is tail (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: A small skeleton with a flattened skull about 50 mm long (number in Cai and Zhao 1999).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Cai and Zhao 1999
